commitments.target: Achieve 1 billion dollars in revenue by FY28.
commitments.quote: See, on the growth, what we have projected $1 billion, we are still sticking on to that
commitments.speaker: Ramesh Kunhikannan

commitments.target: Expect at the minimum 1,500 crores from the OSAT business.
commitments.quote: So, at the minimum, you can expect INR1,500 crores from our OSAT business.
commitments.speaker: Jairam Sampath

commitments.target: Expect about 1,000 crores from the PC Board business.
commitments.quote: Similarly, you can expect about INR1,000 crores from PC Board business.
commitments.speaker: Jairam Sampath

commitments.target: Maintain net working capital between 70 to 85 days.
commitments.quote: So typically, what we expect is about between 70 to 85 days.
commitments.speaker: Jairam Sampath

commitments.target: Spend about another 400-odd crores of capex in this year.
commitments.quote: So you can take broadly in this year, maybe about another INR400-odd crores of capex will be spent.
commitments.speaker: Jairam Sampath

claims.claim: Total revenue stood at 23,837 million with 37 percent year-on-year growth.
claims.quote: Our total revenue stood at INR23,837 million, reflecting a year-on-year growth of 37%.

claims.claim: Operational EBITDA for the quarter was 3,778 million, registering 55 percent growth.
claims.quote: Operational EBITDA for the quarter was INR3,778 million, registering a growth of 55% over the same period last year.

claims.claim: EBITDA margin expanded by 190 basis points year-on-year to 15.9 percent.
claims.quote: This translates into an EBITDA margin of 15.9%, an expansion of 190 basis points year-on-year.

claims.claim: Profit after tax came in at 2,726 million, representing an 11.4 percent PAT margin.
claims.quote: Profit after tax came in at INR2,726 million, representing a PAT margin of 11.4%.

claims.claim: The company has an order book of around 90,000 million pending.
claims.quote: We have an order book of around INR90,000 million, which is pending with us.

claims.claim: The FSA approval under the ISM framework for OSAT is now in place.
claims.quote: I am pleased to confirm that this approval is now in place.

analyst_concerns.quote: So firstly, what is the reason for this? And secondly, we maintain our guidance of bringing down the net working capital to 85 days by March '26.
